show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Hash Power – Ep. 1 - Understanding Blockchains
summary: Hash Power is meant to be an introduction, but really, it is an invitation to explore this emerging world on your own. In the coming weeks, we will cover the technology, the power of decentralization, bitcoin, Ethereum, ICOs, cryptography and hashing. We will spend time with the leading active hedge fund managers in the field, and with outside investors who are both optimistic and skeptical.
